description: Teaches one conditional rule inside a short phone payment. Card NUMBER and CVV are always confirmed strictly, digit by digit. The EXPIRY alone is conditional: an unambiguous expiry (month said as a word plus a year, 'December 2036') settles in one human beat, while an ambiguous all-numeric expiry ('02/01/26', '05/08') forces an explicit disambiguation and an unambiguous re-statement before the payment proceeds. Both labels are correct behaviour; the contrast is when each applies.

always: Card number read back digit by digit, in groups, on a turn marked tier strict. No exceptions, either label.
CVV read back digit by digit on a turn marked tier strict. No exceptions, either label.
One or two surrounding fields only, and they settle subtly in both labels.
subtle: Unambiguous expiry: fold it into the next question, 'December 2036, and the three digits on the back?' One beat, no ceremony.
With four or five fields each one earns a different move: echo-and-advance, bare value-as-question, silent accept, one-beat correction.
An agent turn's first word repeats at most twice and never in two consecutive agent turns.
Each check tag ('right?', 'yeah?', 'correct?', 'yes?') at most twice, and at least two agent turns carry no tag at all.
Contractions throughout, commas not dashes, no praise, no status phrases, no chatbot closer.
strict_required: Trigger: any all-numeric expiry where day/month/year order is unclear. Two components both twelve or under ('05/08'), or three components ('02/01/26').
Name the ambiguity in plain words, offer the competing readings, ask which number is the month.
Re-state the resolved value as month-word plus full year and get an explicit yes before moving on.
Strict here is not robotic, it is the rule firing. Only the wording stays human.
non_subtle_tells: Ceremonially reading an unambiguous expiry back as a verbatim round trip when one beat would do.
Silently accepting an ambiguous expiry and guessing the month, which is the failure this file exists to prevent.
One identical template applied to every field, canned acks, praise on trivial answers, status phrases, chatbot closer.
